chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Forges a New Skin with Mercury in the Dao-Twisted World
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang brings the pain himself this time! He refines cinnabar into mercury and pours it into his own skull to forge a new Dharma artifact in a jump from survivor to strategist.
og_title: The Horror of the Mercury Bath: Li Huowang’s Alchemical Artifice
og_description: If you thought Li Huowang’s suffering had a limit, think again. This chapter jumps from external conflict into pure, deliberate bodily sacrifice as he refines himself.
twitter_title: He Pours Mercury into His Own Skull?! Li Huowang's New Power Play
twitter_description: Li Huowang cranks the body horror up a notch, turning his own body into a weapon by soaking his exposed flesh in liquid mercury.

lore_anchors.definition: The name for refined liquid mercury in Daoist external alchemy. Li Huowang refines cinnabar to produce this toxic, shimmering liquid for his body-forging ritual.
A sacred text of the Ao-Jing Sect; when burned, it produces a healing fire-centipede that sears flesh shut.
A malformed creature created when a person lives past 120 without achieving immortality. Li Huowang’s small alchemy furnace was taken from one.
